## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND shows fear falling and Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +3.99% | 1M: -1.59%) ↑ rising (RECOVERY) plus HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND provide independent confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. Credit mixed but leaning supportive: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.09%) CORRECTION — HYG/LQD net slightly favorable. Stocks vs bonds leadership intact: SPY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-loose: UUP (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION is stable and TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) CORRECTION with Yield Curve (Level) ↓ falling (CORRECTION), so conditions modestly supportive but watch rates.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals/financials leading: XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND are top performers while Tech is lagging: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth given breadth and XLF/XLK split.

**5. US vs Global?**
US showing relative strength: SPY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY while EM weak: EEM (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -11.58%) RECOVERY but fragile.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk tolerated: ARKK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +1.68%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +4.03% | 1M: -8.36%) RECOVERY show appetite, while small caps IWM (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.27%) CORRECTION signals uneven breadth beneath the surface.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals bounce with GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY, but industrial commodity CPER (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -8.15%) RECOVERY suggests mixed demand signals.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND; gas UNG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION is reviving but still fragile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Financials XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector breadth (8/11) support RISK-ON; DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) CORRECTION create a MAJOR divergence across core ETFs—monitor momentum breaks.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND while monitoring bond sensitivity.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND, XLU (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.90%) CORRECTION if risk rally continues.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND and broad oil complex weakness to watch.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) — watch ~20 for complacency; HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) / LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.09%) HYG/LQD inflection ~0.80 for credit health; XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) vs XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) pivot (Tech vs Financials level ~3.25) to signal style shift.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) and XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) showing strength. Key risk: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) weakness and TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) divergence—monitor for momentum rollovers.
